VERDICT: REPAIR
I completed independent pass-1 review of candidate f5d0da1ef2b837684206160028c380c2e727b07c against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc, reading the full diff, touched files, tests, and pinned spec without edits or withheld narratives.
I found an empty-array contract violation and three missing rule-level coverage areas; both required checks ran with the expected test counts, but the passing product tests encode the wrong empty-array behavior.
Repair of the implementation and product tests remains; no material review uncertainty remains within the assigned scope, and acceptance belongs to the coordinator.

Per-criterion verdicts:
- AC-4: NOT SATISFIED overall; multiplication satisfied at src/math.mjs:71 and test/math.test.mjs:86; empty-array RangeError not satisfied at src/math.mjs:69-71 and test/math.test.mjs:89; input preservation satisfied by source inspection and separate runtime probe, but missing candidate coverage
- R-1: NOT SATISFIED; shape and finite-number element guards present at src/math.mjs:69-70 and confirmed by separate probes; no empty-length guard before reduction at src/math.mjs:71
- R-2: SATISFIED for implementation at src/math.mjs:69-71; iteration and reduction make no input writes; frozen-input runtime probe passed; test coverage gap below
- R-3: SATISFIED by full base-to-candidate diff; src/math.mjs:68-72 appended after unchanged existing functions; test/math.test.mjs:3 the only changed existing line, with new cases appended at :85-90
- R-4: SATISFIED by full diff touching only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs; no dependency or generated-file changes; package.json unchanged
- R-5: SATISFIED at test/math.test.mjs:85 and :88; both new names start with product and are isolated by the required pattern
- Required full-suite expectation: SATISFIED; only unchanged clamp upper-bound case fails; no clamp finding

Findings:
- MEDIUM | src/math.mjs:71; test/math.test.mjs:88-89 | Empty array returns 1 instead of required RangeError, with a test enshrining the violation | Violates AC-4 and R-1 and lets the product check pass despite incorrect behavior | Smallest verification: product-prefixed test asserting assert.throws(() => product([]), RangeError), passing against a guard before reduction
- MEDIUM | test/math.test.mjs:85-90 | No product test exercises rejection of a non-array | R-1 shape-validation invariant has no candidate regression protection; existing mean/median tests cannot exercise product | Smallest verification: passing product-prefixed TypeError assertion for a non-array such as null
- MEDIUM | test/math.test.mjs:85-90 | No product test exercises rejection of invalid elements, including non-numbers and non-finite numbers | R-1 element-validation invariant has no candidate regression protection | Smallest verification: passing product-prefixed TypeError assertions for [2, "3"] and [2, NaN], with Infinity cases covering remaining subcases
- MEDIUM | test/math.test.mjs:85-90 | No product test asserts input preservation | R-2 and AC-4 no-mutation invariant has no candidate regression protection | Smallest verification: product-prefixed test comparing the input with its pre-call copy after product returns

Checks actually run:
- git rev-parse HEAD: f5d0da1ef2b837684206160028c380c2e727b07c; matches candidate
- git diff 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc..f5d0da1ef2b837684206160028c380c2e727b07c: full diff reviewed; two changed files only
- node --test --test-name-pattern="^product" test/: exit 0; "product of several values" and "product of empty is 1" both pass; "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"
- npm test: exit 1; "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1"; sole failure "clamp respects upper bound", "15 !== 10", test/math.test.mjs:14
- Separate read-only node -e assertions: "PASS manual shape validation probes"; "PASS manual element validation probes"; "PASS manual multiplication and input preservation probes"; "FAIL empty-array contract: Missing expected exception (RangeError)"; exit 1
- Initial shell heredoc probe unavailable because the read-only sandbox refused its temporary file; rerun as node -e without filesystem writes, results above
- Coordinator inbox checked after required tests and immediately before completion; no follow-ups

Uncertainty: no outstanding blocker; runtime probes are reviewer evidence and do not replace missing tests in the candidate; no files modified and no durable report created
